description: This Java source file defines a Spring Batch tasklet for posting interest to savings accounts within the Apache Fineract microfinance platform. It manages batch processing, thread pool configuration, and interacts with services to retrieve savings account data and schedule interest posting tasks.

classes.name: PostInterestForSavingTasklet
classes.description: A tasklet responsible for orchestrating the posting of interest to savings accounts by batching and multi-threading.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked during batch execution; sets up queues, configures thread pools, retrieves account data, and initiates interest posting.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Handles batching of savings accounts, schedules interest posting tasks, and manages data fetching using concurrent threads.

methods.name: safeSubList
methods.description: Safely creates a sublist from a given list, preventing index out of bounds.

methods.name: checkCompletion
methods.description: Checks if all scheduled futures (threads) have completed successfully and logs errors if not.
